hints.title: Result Ordering

hints.title: String Formatting Query Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
SELECT 
    person_id,
    CONCAT(name, '(', LEFT(profession, 1), ')') AS name
FROM Person
ORDER BY person_id DESC;
```

variables: n: number of rows in Person table
complexity.notes: Sorting by person_id dominating string concatenation per row.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Manual application-layer string concatenation is unnecessary when SQL provides built-in functions.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) memory to format output rows.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Demonstrates correct string concatenation and substring functions across dialect variants.

solutions.code:
SELECT 
    person_id,
    CONCAT(name, '(', LEFT(profession, 1), ')') AS name
FROM Person
ORDER BY person_id DESC;

SELECT 
    person_id,
    name || '(' || SUBSTRING(profession FROM 1 FOR 1) || ')' AS name
FROM Person
ORDER BY person_id DESC;

import pandas as pd

def concatenate_info(person: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    person = person.sort_values(by='person_id', ascending=False)
    person['name'] = person['name'] + '(' + person['profession'].str[0] + ')'
    return person[['person_id', 'name']]
